text:
- **Ask-tool questions on the site:** Agents can now raise ask-tool questions on the site as well as in chat, and the first answer wins. Claude, Codex and the site each received this change, and the parity checks ran live on both runtimes.
- **Agent project-opening rule:** Agents now open a project, sprint or task for work the owner asked for, without asking leave first. The owner-request judge blocks asking that leave as an unneeded question.
- **Faster CI for pm quality:** The Go test suite now does less work on macOS. A PR runs only the Go test packages its changed files can affect. Some PRs now skip the Go matrix, and a docs-only PR passes merge-ready. Median macOS compute fell 20%, and a code PR's wall time fell 16%, but the 90-second target was not met.
- **AGENTS.md checks:** AGENTS.md is now an 11.7 KB map that three runtimes read in full. An agent grades it against a rubric on every PR, through workload identity federation with no stored API key.
- **Benchmark survey:** A survey of long-horizon agent benchmarks for a with-pm comparison was written and recorded. A sprint to choose the first benchmark opened, and its choice is still to be raised to the owner.
